contextAndNativeEntries.scope: Actual MAIN production MON owner and canonical actor/map/table state; all source members, native scalar/output/list aliases, growth/lifetime, guarded full signedlong ALIGNLIM values, fixed native entry bypass and exceptional cleanup. Iterator mutation and original-C gameplay comparisons are separate.

iterationVisibilityAndAnimalLookup.scope: Actual original C restore hiding and monster flashing (each two native reads and writes with byte restoration), complete animal lookup construction and 32 ordered source selections, and MON iterators on genuine MAIN worlds; original source actor creation and current/next removal, nested snapshot reuse, early stop and signed boolean widths, direct native and genuine pointer callbacks, coordinate narrowing, exact observed visitation and result IDs. Complete worlds, both ISAAC states/logs, terminal/input/frames compare. Snapshot source capacity/release policy uses zero C bytes in JS. Observer C adds forwarding/control/logging only; no original engine policy edits. Every migration/game-end/callback failure/hidden recording branch is not claimed.

ordinaryTurns.scope: Real initial walk, wait and forced attack; input through pending output and next read. Generic C field access and pointer-table dispatch are also counted; C malloc includes this runtime's C-stack allocations. Counters are architectural acceptance, not CPU or timing samples.

statusTurns.scope: Source make_confused/make_stunned/reset at declared real command input boundaries, with actual changed-direction RNG. Complete command snapshots, world graph, both ISAAC states/logs, terminal bytes/frames and raw More input match original C. No fabricated map/monster or raw status-field writes. This does not cover all water/air turbulence, punishment, bars or polymorph combinations.

cleanupDiagnostic.scope: Explicit mismatched iflags.purge_monsters diagnostic fixture on a real MAIN world. Original dmonsfree/describe_level/impossible execute, including actual lazy byte materialization; full game graph, both ISAAC states/logs, terminal bytes/frames and input match C. This is error-path validation, not a natural gameplay claim.

petAndAppraisal.limits: Actual source MAIN and source-created actors/items, full world graphs, both ISAAC states/logs, exact terminal/frames and input consumption. Food/artifact/resistance/shudder queries, real source artifact gift, source taming, elapsed-time, direct iterator callback and same-level migration/arrival compared. This does not claim every species/item/migration failure, alternate level, endgame or hidden recording.

mountedSaves.scope: Natural Knight riding through literal MAIN commands and four fresh cross-fed mounted save consumers; no wishes, setup policy calls, raw game writes or input-state cleanup. This bounded interaction is not natural full-game victory.

positive.label: positive branches
positive.messageBuffer: The vampire turns into a fog cloud!  Something spins a web.

privateMovementGameplay.scope: Source-created vampire/invisible spider in live MAIN input callback; original private functions are forwarding exports in the complete C oracle. No raw fields/input-depth/RNG writes or natural AI-journey claim.

legacyFixture.scope: Preserved isolated-C compatibility factory with controlled foreign world, distinct from actual production gameplay.
